review_response_tasks.rationale: 缺少确切停钟原因/时间/过程，全文调查故障兼容why/when/how三种嵌入问句，不强行只收预期why。
inspection前描述谨慎的形容词，careful符合后文细致操作；未列别的词形待复核。
英美过去分词作diagrams定语，两种拼写均可。
本句 removed the smaller ... and placed them on a cloth 中，them回指取下并放在布上的多个齿轮，wheels用复数；上一句several限定的是diagrams，不能把它当作本空的直接限定词。
in which结构中which作介词宾语；where不能接在in后重复地点成分。
after后动名词及完成动名词均表示使用干刷先于询问；不用avoid+完成式这一含混时间关系凑变体。
but构成not X, but Y的目的对照；only或just可把后一to不定式限定为真正目的，not to make the clock look new, only/just to make it work均合当前语境。三种一词形式都接受；不因原参考仅列but排除。原and显式排除缺少充分唯一性论证，移为未列形式待复核，不认定它已被核实正确。
by the time specialist visited且准备先于来访，过去完成形式。 过去完成进行式也能表示截至该过去时点已经持续进行的活动；不以原预期仅列完成式排除。
since April允许完成及完成进行；visitors复数。
delighted后普通/完成不定式均与已收到的补充材料相容。

student_passage:
The clock above the entrance to our disused railway station had stopped at ten past four. Nobody knew exactly (1) ____ it had stopped, so a local history group decided to investigate. The work began with a (2) ____ (care) inspection of the mechanism. Inside the case were several (3) ____ (label) diagrams that an earlier repairer had left behind. Their presence suggested that somebody had already tried to understand the fault.

Two volunteers removed the smaller (4) ____ (wheel) and placed them on a cloth. Each component was numbered before it was cleaned. One volunteer recorded the order in (5) ____ the parts had been removed, while the other checked the teeth for damage. After (6) ____ (use) a dry brush to remove the dust, they asked a specialist about the material before trying any cleaning liquid. Their aim was not to make the clock look new, (7) ____ to make it work without destroying evidence of earlier repairs.

By the time the specialist visited, the group (8) ____ (prepare) a complete set of photographs. She used these to identify a bent pin hidden behind the main dial. Since the clock began running again in April, visitors (9) ____ (send) the group several old station photographs. The volunteers are delighted (10) ____ (receive) these unexpected additions to the story. The clock now tells the time, but the display beside it also records how a careful sequence of small decisions brought it back into use.
